items.title: Verify lifecycle security and vulnerability controls
items.result: No documentary verification was completed; all three controls remain unconfirmed. If verification identifies a deficiency, document security-by-design, patching, and vulnerability procedures with owners, timelines, testing, escalation, and disclosure criteria.

items.title: Verify supplier risk, contract, and continuity controls
items.result: Questionnaire responses were reviewed; all three supply-chain controls remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, inventory important suppliers, update security clauses, and document outage and exit procedures.

items.title: Verify incident readiness and reporting controls
items.result: No verification evidence was provided; all four controls remain unconfirmed. If verification identifies a deficiency, create an incident plan, assign contacts, implement traceable records, and establish reporting deadlines.

items.title: Verify access governance and authentication controls
items.result: No documentary verification evidence was supplied; all three controls remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document access reviews, lifecycle deprovisioning, and MFA coverage.

items.title: Verify documented information-security responsibility
items.result: No documentary evidence was supplied; responsibility designation remains unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, appoint and document an information-security owner or responsible team.

items.title: Verify management security oversight
items.result: No documentary evidence was supplied; management approval and oversight remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document management approvals, oversight activities, and review decisions for security measures.

items.title: Verify management cybersecurity training
items.result: No documentary evidence was supplied; regular management cybersecurity training remains unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, establish recurring cybersecurity training and retain attendance and completion records.

items.title: Verify training records and cyber-hygiene rules
items.result: No supporting training records or cyber-hygiene rules were provided; both gaps remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, deliver recurring role-based training and publish accessible, binding cyber-hygiene rules.

items.title: Verify Backup and Recovery Controls
items.result: No supporting records were provided; backup frequency, protection, restoration testing, and recovery planning remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document backup schedules, isolated protections, restoration tests, recovery objectives, and assigned responsibilities.
suggestedEvidence: Emergency recovery plan and responsibility matrix

items.title: Verify Reviews and Deficiency Tracking
items.result: Reviewed available records; no supporting evidence was provided. Effectiveness reviews and remediation tracking remain unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document recurring effectiveness reviews and track deficiencies with owners, deadlines, status, and closure evidence.

items.title: Verify risk analysis and critical asset inventory
items.result: Reviewed the supplied responses; all four areas remain unverified because no organization records were provided. If verification identifies a deficiency, document the risk analysis, update triggers, criticality map, and current asset inventory.

items.title: Verify encryption controls
items.result: Reviewed supplied materials; no organization evidence was provided, so encryption remains unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document encryption requirements and test coverage for sensitive data and important connections.

items.title: Verify communication resilience
items.result: Reviewed supplied materials; no organization evidence was provided, so communication resilience remains unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document primary and fallback communication channels and test emergency failover.

items.title: Verify physical protection
items.result: Reviewed supplied materials; no organization evidence was provided, so physical protection remains unverified. If verification identifies a deficiency, document access controls and hazard protections for systems and rooms; test safeguards.
